import { computed } from 'vue';
import type { AriaAttributes } from 'vue';

// Vue透传的标准ARIA与本预览专用DOM事件；不放宽未知业务属性或事件。
declare module 'vue' {
	interface ComponentCustomProps {
		'aria-label'?: string;
		'aria-current'?: AriaAttributes['aria-current'];
	}
	interface HTMLAttributes {
		onAsamPreviewTheme?: (event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) => void;
	}
}

/** 公共输入允许清空或多种标量，页面模型只接收自己声明的合法值。 */
export function choiceModel<Value extends string | number>(
	read: () => Value,
	write: (value: Value) => void,
	choices: readonly Value[]
) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (choices.some((choice) => Object.is(choice, value))) write(value as Value);
		}
	});
}
export function booleanModel(read: () => boolean, write: (value: boolean) => void) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (typeof value === 'boolean') write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function textModel(read: () => string, write: (value: string) => void) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value: unknown) {
			if (typeof value === 'string') write(value);
		}
	});
}

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import type { Ref } from 'vue';

export function useDashboardMetricLayout(page: Readonly<Ref<HTMLElement | null>>) {
	const width = shallowRef(1440);
	const columns = computed(() => (width.value < 700 ? 1 : width.value < 1100 ? 2 : 4));
	let observer: ResizeObserver | undefined;

	onMounted(() => {
		const element = page.value;
		if (!element) return;
		const measure = () => {
			width.value = element.getBoundingClientRect().width;
		};
		measure();
		observer = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		observer.observe(element);
	});
	onBeforeUnmount(() => observer?.disconnect());

	return { width, columns };
}

import { reactive, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import type { SubscribeSource } from '../../visualization/Types.js';
import { monitorRegions, monitorStreams } from './Types.js';
import type { BusinessMonitorHost, BusinessStream } from './Types.js';

/** 本地源严格遵守已有SubscribeSource；不创建EventSource或真实接口。 */
export function createBusinessMonitorFixture() {
	const controls = reactive({
		mode: 'normal' as 'normal' | 'empty' | 'partial' | 'error',
		delayMs: 80,
		identity: 1
	});
	const audit = reactive({ subscriptions: 0, closed: 0, active: 0, delivered: 0 });
	const cleanups = new Set<() => void>();
	const source: SubscribeSource = {
		id: 'local-business-monitor',
		subscribe(sink) {
			++audit.subscriptions;
			++audit.active;
			let active = true,
				tick = 0,
				interval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
			const identity = controls.identity,
				mode = controls.mode,
				delay = controls.delayMs;
			function emit(
				stream: BusinessStream,
				seq: number,
				value: number | null,
				at = Date.now()
			) {
				if (!active) return;
				++audit.delivered;
				sink.message({ stream, seq, at, value });
			}
			function frame() {
				const values: Record<BusinessStream, number> = {
					online: 1286 + tick,
					processed: 9120 + (tick % 10) * 20,
					response: 1.8,
					success: 99.6,
					goal: 12000,
					current: 90,
					previous: 65,
					north: 3200,
					south: 2400,
					east: 1900,
					west: 1620,
					asset: 2846,
					workflow: 1927,
					knowledge: 1456,
					backlog: 128,
					assetChange: 12.6,
					workflowChange: 8.2,
					knowledgeChange: 6.8,
					backlogChange: -5.2
				};
				for (const stream of monitorStreams) {
					if (
						stream === 'current' ||
						stream === 'previous' ||
						monitorRegions.some((region) => region === stream)
					)
						continue;
					emit(
						stream,
						tick,
						mode === 'empty' || (mode === 'partial' && stream === 'response')
							? null
							: values[stream] * (stream === 'online' ? identity : 1)
					);
				}
				const length = tick === 0 ? 12 : 1;
				for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
					const seq = tick === 0 ? i : 11 + tick;
					const at = Date.now() - (length - i - 1) * 1000;
					monitorRegions.forEach((region, index) =>
						emit(
							region,
							seq,
							mode === 'empty' || (mode === 'partial' && region === 'east')
								? null
								: values[region] + ((seq % 12) - 11) * (index + 1) * 9,
							at
						)
					);
					emit(
						'current',
						seq,
						mode === 'empty'
							? null
							: [39, 62, 51, 84, 65, 93, 58, 78, 63, 88, 98, 73][seq % 12]!,
						at
					);
					emit(
						'previous',
						seq,
						mode === 'empty'
							? null
							: [30, 42, 44, 59, 48, 65, 50, 67, 46, 74, 79, 65][seq % 12]!,
						at
					);
				}
				++tick;
			}
			function close() {
				if (!active) return;
				active = false;
				clearTimeout(initial);
				if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
				++audit.closed;
				--audit.active;
				cleanups.delete(close);
			}
			const initial = setTimeout(() => {
				if (!active) return;
				if (mode === 'error') {
					sink.error();
					return;
				}
				sink.open();
				frame();
				interval = setInterval(frame, 1000);
			}, delay);
			cleanups.add(close);
			return { close };
		}
	};
	const host = shallowRef<BusinessMonitorHost>({ owner: { identity: 1 }, source });
	return {
		host,
		controls,
		audit,
		switchIdentity() {
			++controls.identity;
			host.value = { owner: { identity: controls.identity }, source };
		},
		dispose() {
			for (const close of [...cleanups]) close();
		}
	};
}

		:aria-busy="state.status.value === 'loading'"
	>
		<header class="monitor-heading">
			<div>
				<p class="monitor-eyebrow">{{ t('eyebrow') }}</p>
				<h1>{{ t('title') }}</h1>
				<p>{{ t('intro') }}</p>
			</div>
			<div class="monitor-actions">
				<AsamTag :type="state.snapshot.value.state === 'live' ? 'success' : 'info'">{{
					stateLabel
				}}</AsamTag
				><AsamButton
					v-if="state.snapshot.value.state === 'paused'"
					type="primary"
					plain
					@click="state.resume"
					>{{ t('resume') }}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton
					v-else
					type="primary"
					plain
					:disabled="
						!['live', 'connecting', 'stale'].includes(state.snapshot.value.state)
					"
					@click="state.pause"
					>{{ t('pause') }}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton @click="state.reconnect" type="primary">{{
					t('reconnect')
				}}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton
					:disabled="state.snapshot.value.state === 'closed'"
					@click="state.close"
					type="primary"
					>{{ t('close') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</div>
		</header>
		<p class="monitor-status" role="status">
			{{ feedback
			}}<AsamButton
				v-if="state.status.value === 'error'"
				@click="state.reconnect"
				type="primary"
				>{{ t('retry') }}</AsamButton
			>
		</p>
		<AsamCardGroup :label="t('metrics')" :columns="columns" class="monitor-metrics"
			><AsamStatisticCard
				v-for="metric in metrics"
				:key="metric.id"
				title=""
				:label="t(metric.id)"
				:value="metric.value"
				:precision="metric.id === 'response' || metric.id === 'success' ? 1 : 0"
				:unit="
					metric.id === 'response'
						? t('seconds')
						: metric.id === 'success'
							? '%'
							: undefined
				"
				:status="state.status.value"
				:empty-text="t('empty')"
				:error-text="t('error')"
		/></AsamCardGroup>
		<div class="monitor-main-grid">
			<AsamCard shadow="never" class="monitor-section" :body-style="bodyStyle"
				><ChartHost
					:title="t('trend')"
					:series="trend"
					:loading="state.status.value === 'loading'"
					:error="chartError"
					:theme="theme"
					:locale="chartLocale"
					:height="260"
					@retry="state.reconnect"
					><template #extra
						><AsamSelect
							class="monitor-region-filter"
							:aria-label="t('regionFilter')"
							:model-value="region"
							@update:model-value="selectRegion"
							><AsamOption value="all" :label="t('allRegions')" /><AsamOption
								v-for="id in monitorRegions"
								:key="id"
								:value="id"
								:label="t(id)" /></AsamSelect></template></ChartHost></AsamCard
			><AsamCard
				:title="t('goal')"
				shadow="never"
				class="monitor-section monitor-goal"
				:body-style="bodyStyle"
				><template v-if="goalProgress"
					><div class="monitor-goal-number">
						<strong>{{ number(goalProgress.percentage) }}<small>%</small></strong>
						<p>{{ t('goalRate') }}</p>
					</div>
					<AsamProgress :percentage="goalProgress.percentage" :stroke-width="8" />
					<div class="monitor-summary">
						<span>{{ t('target') }} {{ number(goalProgress.goal) }}</span
						><span>{{ t('completed') }} {{ number(goalProgress.processed) }}</span>
					</div>
					<AsamDivider />
					<p>{{ t('remaining') }} {{ number(goalProgress.remaining) }}</p></template
				><AsamEmpty
					v-else
					:description="
						t(
							state.status.value === 'loading'
								? 'loading'
								: state.status.value === 'error'
									? 'error'
									: 'noRows'
						)
					"
			/></AsamCard>
		</div>
		<div class="monitor-equal-grid">
			<AsamCard shadow="never" class="monitor-section" :body-style="bodyStyle"
				><ChartHost
					:title="t('regions')"
					:series="regions"
					:loading="state.status.value === 'loading'"
					:error="chartError"
					:theme="theme"
					:locale="chartLocale"
					:height="260"
					@select="selectRegion($event.pointId)"
					@retry="state.reconnect" /></AsamCard
			><AsamCard
				:title="t('hotspots')"
				shadow="never"
				class="monitor-section"
				:body-style="bodyStyle"
				><AsamTable
					:data="hotspots"
					:empty-text="
						t(
							state.status.value === 'loading'
								? 'loading'
								: state.status.value === 'error'
									? 'error'
									: 'noRows'
						)
					"
					><!-- @vue-generic {HotspotRow} --><AsamTableColumn
						prop="label"
						:label="t('task')"
						min-width="160"
					/><!-- @vue-generic {HotspotRow} --><AsamTableColumn
						:label="t('value')"
						min-width="100"
						align="right"
						><template #default="{ row }">{{
							row.value === null ? t('unavailable') : number(row.value)
						}}</template></AsamTableColumn
					><!-- @vue-generic {HotspotRow} --><AsamTableColumn
						:label="t('change')"
						min-width="100"
						align="right"
						><template #default="{ row }"
							><AsamTag
								v-if="row.change !== null"
								:type="row.change >= 0 ? 'success' : 'warning'"
								>{{ row.change > 0 ? '+' : '' }}{{ number(row.change) }}%</AsamTag
							><span v-else>{{ t('unavailable') }}</span></template
						></AsamTableColumn
					></AsamTable
				></AsamCard
			>
		</div>
		<p class="monitor-updated">{{ t('latest') }} {{ updatedAt }}</p>
	</main>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide, shallowRef, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCard,
	AsamButton,
	AsamOption,
	AsamSelect,
	AsamTag,
	AsamProgress,
	AsamDivider,
	AsamTable,
	AsamTableColumn,
	AsamEmpty
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { AsamCardGroup, AsamStatisticCard } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {} from '../../cards/Models.js';
import ChartHost from '../../visualization/ChartHost.vue';
import type { ChartSeries, ConnectionState } from '../../visualization/Types.js';
import { businessValue, monitorRegions } from './Types.js';
import type { BusinessMonitorHost, BusinessStream } from './Types.js';
import { useBusinessMonitor } from './State.js';
import { useBusinessMonitorText } from './I18n.js';
import { useDashboardMetricLayout } from '../MetricLayout.js';
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ host: BusinessMonitorHost; theme?: 'light' | 'dark' }>(), {
	theme: 'light'
});
const { i18n, t } = useBusinessMonitorText();
provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
const { width, columns } = useDashboardMetricLayout(useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('page'));
const state = useBusinessMonitor(() => props.host),
	locale = computed(() => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh-CN')),
	chartLocale = computed(() => (locale.value === 'en' ? 'EN' : 'ZH'));
const stateLabel = computed(
	() =>
		(
			({
				idle: t('idle'),
				connecting: t('connecting'),
				live: t('live'),
				reconnecting: t('reconnecting'),
				paused: t('statePaused'),
				stale: t('stateStale'),
				error: t('stateError'),
				closed: t('stateClosed')
			}) satisfies Record<ConnectionState, string>
		)[state.snapshot.value.state]
);
const feedback = computed(() =>
	t(
		state.snapshot.value.state === 'paused'
			? 'paused'
			: state.snapshot.value.state === 'closed'
				? 'closed'
				: state.snapshot.value.state === 'stale'
					? 'stale'
					: state.status.value === 'loading'
						? 'loading'
						: state.status.value === 'error'
							? 'error'
							: state.status.value === 'empty'
								? 'empty'
								: state.partial.value
									? 'partial'
									: 'ready'
	)
);
const value = (id: BusinessStream) => businessValue(state.visible.value, id);
const metrics = computed(() =>
	(['online', 'processed', 'response', 'success'] as const).map((id) => ({
		id,
		value: value(id)
	}))
);
const goalProgress = computed(() => {
	const goal = value('goal'),
		processed = value('processed');
	if (goal === null || goal <= 0 || processed === null) return undefined;
	return {
		goal,
		processed,
		remaining: Math.max(0, goal - processed),
		percentage: Math.min(100, Math.round((processed / goal) * 1000) / 10)
	};
});
const number = (value: number) =>
	new Intl.NumberFormat(locale.value, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(value);
const date = (value: number) =>
	new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale.value, {
		hour: '2-digit',
		minute: '2-digit',
		second: '2-digit'
	}).format(value);
type Region = (typeof monitorRegions)[number];
const region = shallowRef<Region | 'all'>('all');
function selectRegion(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'all') {
		region.value = value;
		return;
	}
	const selected = monitorRegions.find((id) => id === value);
	if (selected) region.value = selected;
}
const trend = computed<ChartSeries[]>(() => {
	const streams: readonly (Region | 'current' | 'previous')[] =
		region.value === 'all' ? ['current', 'previous'] : [region.value];
	return streams.map((id) => ({
		id,
		name: t(id),
		kind: 'line',
		points: (state.visible.value?.points[id] ?? []).map((p) => ({
			id: String(p.seq),
			label: date(p.at),
			value: p.value
		}))
	}));
});
const regions = computed<ChartSeries[]>(() => [
	{
		id: 'regions',
		name: t('regions'),
		kind: 'bar',
		points: monitorRegions.map((id) => ({
			id,
			label: t(id),
			value: value(id)
		}))
	}
]);
interface HotspotRow {
	id: string;
	label: string;
	value: number | null;
	change: number | null;
}
const hotspots = computed<HotspotRow[]>(() =>
	!state.visible.value || state.status.value === 'empty'
		? []
		: (['asset', 'workflow', 'knowledge', 'backlog'] as const).map((id) => ({
				id,
				label: t(id),
				value: value(id),
				change: value(`${id}Change`)
			}))
);
const updatedAt = computed(() => {
	const at = state.visible.value?.lastAt;
	return at === undefined || at === null ? t('unavailable') : date(at);
});
const chartError = computed(() => (state.status.value === 'error' ? t('error') : ''));
const bodyStyle = { padding: 'var(--asam-space-xl)' };
</script>

import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { createMonitor } from '../../visualization/Monitor.js';
import type { MonitorSnapshot } from '../../visualization/Types.js';
import { businessValue, monitorStreams } from './Types.js';
import type { BusinessMonitorHost } from './Types.js';

/** 每页独立容器；只编排宿主变化，连接/时序/缓冲/取消仍由既有Monitor实现。 */
export function useBusinessMonitor(host: () => BusinessMonitorHost) {
	const snapshot = shallowRef<MonitorSnapshot>({
		state: 'idle',
		source: '',
		attempts: 0,
		dropped: 0,
		lastAt: null,
		points: {}
	});
	let monitor: ReturnType<typeof createMonitor> | undefined;
	let disposed = false;
	watch(
		() => [host().owner, host().source] as const,
		() => {
			monitor?.dispose();
			monitor = createMonitor(
				{
					streams: [...monitorStreams],
					capacity: 60,
					intervalMs: 1000,
					batchMs: 100,
					reconnects: 0
				},
				(value) => {
					snapshot.value = value;
				}
			);
			snapshot.value = monitor.snapshot();
			monitor.start(host().source);
		},
		{ immediate: true, flush: 'sync' }
	);
	const visible = computed(() =>
		['live', 'paused', 'stale'].includes(snapshot.value.state) ? snapshot.value : undefined
	);
	const available = computed(() =>
		monitorStreams.some((id) => businessValue(visible.value, id) !== null)
	);
	const status = computed(() =>
		'error' === snapshot.value.state
			? 'error'
			: ['idle', 'connecting', 'reconnecting'].includes(snapshot.value.state)
				? 'loading'
				: available.value
					? 'ready'
					: 'empty'
	);
	const partial = computed(
		() =>
			available.value &&
			monitorStreams.some((id) => businessValue(visible.value, id) === null)
	);
	onScopeDispose(() => {
		disposed = true;
		monitor?.dispose();
		snapshot.value = {
			state: 'closed',
			source: '',
			attempts: 0,
			dropped: 0,
			lastAt: null,
			points: {}
		};
	});
	return {
		snapshot: computed(() => snapshot.value),
		visible,
		status,
		partial,
		pause: () => monitor?.pause(),
		resume: () => monitor?.resume(),
		reconnect: () => monitor?.reconnect(),
		close: () => monitor?.close(),
		resources: () => monitor?.resources(),
		get disposed() {
			return disposed;
		}
	};
}
ts
import type { MonitorSource, MonitorSnapshot } from '../../visualization/Types.js';

export const monitorRegions = ['north', 'south', 'east', 'west'] as const;

export const monitorStreams = [
	'online',
	'processed',
	'response',
	'success',
	'goal',
	'current',
	'previous',
	...monitorRegions,
	'asset',
	'workflow',
	'knowledge',
	'backlog',
	'assetChange',
	'workflowChange',
	'knowledgeChange',
	'backlogChange'
] as const;
export type BusinessStream = (typeof monitorStreams)[number];
/** 真实数据映射归宿主；身份或权限变化必须替换owner引用。 */
export interface BusinessMonitorHost {
	readonly owner: object;
	readonly source: MonitorSource;
}
/** 空或业务范围不合法的值保持缺失，不将缺失补成零。 */
export function businessValue(
	snapshot: MonitorSnapshot | undefined,
	stream: BusinessStream
): number | null {
	const value = snapshot?.points[stream]?.at(-1)?.value;
	if (value === undefined || value === null || !Number.isFinite(value)) return null;
	if (!stream.endsWith('Change') && value < 0) return null;
	if (stream === 'success' && value > 100) return null;
	return value;
}

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
/** 演示宿主拥有本地源；外部语言实例仍归调用者。 */
export function mountMonitorWorkspace(
	element: Element,
	host?: { i18n?: AsamI18n; inheritAppearance?: boolean; diagnostics?: boolean },
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void
) {
	const locale = shallowRef<'zh-CN' | 'en'>('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const app = createApp(App, {
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		diagnostics: host?.diagnostics,
		onLocale: (value: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'dashboard-monitor-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

<template>
	<section class="viz-chart" :aria-label="title" :aria-busy="loading">

								</td>

						>

			</div>
		</details>
	</section>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamFormSection } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamCheckboxItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { useVisualizationI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
const i18n = useVisualizationI18n();
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import type { EChartsType, EChartsCoreOption } from 'echarts/core';
import type { ChartProps, ChartExpose, ChartSelection } from './Types.js';
import { validateSeries } from './Data.js';
import { loadEngine } from './EngineLoader.js';
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ChartProps>(), {
	loading: false,
	showTable: false,
	reducedMotion: undefined,
	theme: 'light',
	locale: 'ZH',
	height: 280
});
const emit = defineEmits<{
	ready: [];
	retry: [];
	select: [selection: ChartSelection];
	legend: [selection: Record<string, boolean>];
	zoom: [event: unknown];
	error: [message: string];
}>();
defineSlots<{ extra?: () => unknown }>();
const container = ref<HTMLDivElement>();
const selected = ref<Record<string, boolean>>({});
const engineError = ref('');
const engineFailure = ref<'renderFailed' | 'engineFailed'>();
const diagnostic = computed(
	() =>
		props.error ||
		validateSeries(props.series, i18n) ||
		(engineFailure.value && i18n.enabled.value
			? i18n.t(

import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { ChartSeries } from './Types.js';
/** Validate before invoking the engine. Null is a gap, zero and signed decimals are values. */
export function validateSeries(
	series: readonly ChartSeries[],
	scope?: AsamI18n
): string | undefined {
	const ids = new Set<string>();
	for (const item of series) {
		if (!item.id || ids.has(item.id))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.seriesId')
				: 'series ID 缺失或重复';
		ids.add(item.id);
		if (!['line', 'bar', 'pie'].includes(item.kind))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.chartKind')
				: '未注册的图表类型';
		const points = new Set<string>();
		for (const point of item.points) {
			if (!point.id || points.has(point.id))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.pointId')
					: 'point ID 缺失或重复';
			points.add(point.id);
			if (point.value !== null && !Number.isFinite(point.value))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.finite')
					: '图表值必须为有限数字或 null';
			if (item.kind === 'pie' && point.value !== null && point.value < 0)
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.negativePie')
					: '饼图不支持负数；请使用折线或柱图';
		}
	}
}

import type * as ChartEngine from './Engine.js';
/** Vite resolves this marker to its own emitted entry, including the configured base URL.
 * A fresh URL on retry avoids the browser's cached rejected dynamic-import promise.
 * No remote scripts, copied engine code or alternate dependency instance are used.

export async function loadEngine(attempt: number): Promise<typeof ChartEngine> {
	if (loaded) return loaded;

	if (attempt > 0) url.searchParams.set('asam-retry', String(attempt));
	const engine: typeof ChartEngine = await import(/* @vite-ignore */ url.href);
	loaded = engine;

}

import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type {

	MonitorSnapshot,

function bounded(value: number | undefined, fallback: number, min: number, max: number) {

export function createMonitor(
	options: MonitorOptions,

	if (!options.streams.length || new Set(options.streams).size !== options.streams.length)
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('唯一流 ID 必填'),
			'app.templates.visualization.streamRequired'
		);

	const interval = bounded(options.intervalMs, 100, 50, 60_000);
	const batch = bounded(options.batchMs, 100, 100, 10_000);

	const backoff = bounded(options.backoffMs, 1000, 100, 10_000);

	let subscription: Subscription | undefined;
	let request: AbortController | undefined;

	let receivedAt = 0;
	let startedAt = 0;

		options.streams.map((id) => [id, []])
	);

		return {
			state,
			source: source?.id ?? '',

			timers.delete(timer);

		}
	}

		start(next: MonitorSource) {
			if (destroyed) return;
			cleanup();
			source = next;
			attempts = 0;
			lastAt = null;
			for (const id of options.streams) points[id] = [];

		pause() {
			if (destroyed) return;
			cleanup();

			publish();
		},
		resume() {
			if (!destroyed && state === 'paused') {

		reconnect() {
			if (!destroyed) {

			}
		},
		close() {
			if (destroyed) return;
			cleanup();
			state = 'closed';
			publish();
		},
		dispose() {
			cleanup();
			state = 'closed';
			destroyed = true;
		},
		snapshot,
		resources: () => ({
			timers: timers.size,
			subscription: !!subscription,
			request: !!request,
			pending: Object.values(pending).reduce((n, p) => n + p.length, 0)
		})
	};
}
css
.viz-shell {
	--viz-bg: var(--asam-color-surface-muted, #f3f6f7);
	--viz-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--viz-text: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #20363e);
	--viz-border: var(--asam-color-border, #d8e1e5);
	--viz-control: 32px;
	background: var(--viz-bg);
	color: var(--viz-text);
	min-height: 100%;
	font: 14px/1.5 var(--asam-typography-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);
}
.viz-shell.dark {
	color-scheme: dark;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='large'] {
	--viz-control: 40px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='big'] {
	--viz-control: 36px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='small'] {
	--viz-control: 28px;
}
body {
	margin: 0;
}
.viz-shell * {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.viz-shell nav {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	padding: 16px 3vw;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.viz-shell nav strong {
	margin-right: auto;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-shell small {
	font-size: 10px;
	font-weight: 400;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell select:not([class*='el-']) {
	font: inherit;
	color: inherit;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control, 4px);
	min-height: var(--viz-control);
	line-height: 20px;
	padding: 3px 10px;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
	cursor: pointer;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']):hover,
.viz-shell [aria-current='page']:not(.el-button) {
	border-color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
}
.viz-shell :focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-'])[type='checkbox'] {
	min-height: 0;
}
.viz-page {
	max-width: 1600px;
	margin: auto;
	padding: 28px 3vw;
}
.viz-heading {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.viz-heading h1 {
	font-size: 32px;
	letter-spacing: -0.035em;
	margin: 4px 0;
}
.viz-heading p {
	margin: 0;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-eyebrow {
	font-size: 11px;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-toolbar {
	display: flex;
	align-items: end;
	gap: 12px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.viz-toolbar label {
	display: grid;
	gap: 4px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-shell nav label {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 5px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
	gap: 18px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid > .viz-chart:first-child {
	grid-column: 1/-1;
}
.viz-monitor-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
	gap: 16px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-chart {
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 18px;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card, 8px);
}
.viz-chart header {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
}
.viz-chart h2 {
	font-size: 15px;
	margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section {
	border: 0;
	padding: 0;
	display: flex;
	gap: 12px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section-title {
	font-size: 11px;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-plot {
	width: 100%;
}
.viz-chart summary {
	cursor: pointer;
	font-size: 12px;
	margin-top: 12px;
}
.viz-table {
	max-height: 260px;
	overflow: auto;
}
.viz-table table {
	border-collapse: collapse;
	width: 100%;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-table th,
.viz-table td {
	text-align: left;
	padding: 6px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
}
.viz-status {
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	padding: 6px 12px;
	border-radius: 20px;
}
.viz-shell .asam-card-group {
	margin: 18px 0;
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.viz-analysis-grid,
	.viz-monitor-grid {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.viz-heading h1 {
		font-size: 26px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav {
		gap: 9px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav strong {
		width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-toolbar input:not([class*='el-']) {
		max-width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-chart {
		padding: 12px;
	}
	.viz-page {
		padding: 20px 14px;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
		transition:
			border-color 0.15s,
			color 0.15s;
	}
	.viz-page {
		animation: viz-enter 0.18s ease-out;
	}
	@keyframes viz-enter {
		from {
			opacity: 0.4;
			transform: translateY(3px);
		}
		to {
			opacity: 1;
			transform: none;
		}
	}
}

import type { EChartsCoreOption, EChartsType } from 'echarts/core';
export type ChartKind = 'line' | 'bar' | 'pie';
export interface ChartPoint {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly label: string;
	readonly value: number | null;
}
export interface ChartSeries {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly name: string;
	readonly kind: ChartKind;
	readonly points: readonly ChartPoint[];
	readonly color?: string;
}
export interface ChartSelection {
	seriesId: string;
	pointId: string;
	index: number;
	value: number | null;
}
export interface ChartProps {
	title: string;
	series: readonly ChartSeries[];
	/** Trusted application option only. Never deserialize executable formatters from remote input. */
	option?: EChartsCoreOption;
	loading?: boolean;
	error?: string;
	theme?: 'light' | 'dark';
	locale?: 'ZH' | 'EN';
	/** Omitted follows the live system preference; explicit false enables animation. */
	reducedMotion?: boolean;
	showTable?: boolean;
	height?: number;
}
export interface ChartExpose {
	resize(): void;
	dispose(): void;
	getInstance(): EChartsType | undefined;
	dispatchAction(action: Parameters<EChartsType['dispatchAction']>[0]): void;
	getDataURL(): string | undefined;
}
export type ConnectionState =
	'idle' | 'connecting' | 'live' | 'reconnecting' | 'paused' | 'stale' | 'error' | 'closed';
export interface StreamPoint {
	readonly stream: string;
	readonly seq: number;
	readonly at: number;
	readonly value: number | null;
}
export interface Subscription {
	close(): void;
}
export interface StreamSink {
	open(): void;
	message(point: StreamPoint): void;
	error(): void;
}
export interface SubscribeSource {
	readonly id: string;
	subscribe(sink: StreamSink): Subscription;
}
export interface PollSource {
	readonly id: string;
	poll(signal: AbortSignal): Promise<readonly StreamPoint[]>;
}
export type MonitorSource = SubscribeSource | PollSource;
export interface MonitorOptions {
	streams: readonly string[];
	capacity?: number;
	intervalMs?: number;
	batchMs?: number;
	reconnects?: number;
	backoffMs?: number;
}
export interface MonitorSnapshot {
	state: ConnectionState;
	source: string;
	attempts: number;
	dropped: number;
	lastAt: number | null;
	points: Readonly<Record<string, readonly StreamPoint[]>>;
}
export interface AnalyticsFilter {
	category: 'all' | 'north' | 'south';
	range: number;
	mode: 'normal' | 'empty' | 'partial' | 'error';
	delayMs?: number;
}
export interface AnalyticsData {
	readonly points: readonly ChartPoint[];
	readonly total: number;
	readonly partial: boolean;
}

import { resolve, relative } from 'node:path';

// Keep the accepted loader's retryable dynamic import. Only resolve its URL to
// Vite's own emitted entry; the engine and chart algorithms remain unchanged.
export function asamVisualizationEngine(
	sourceRoot = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..'),
	{ language = 'ts' } = {}
) {
	if (!['ts', 'js'].includes(language)) throw Error('图表引擎仅支持TS或JS同源入口');
	const engine = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/Engine.${language}`);
	const loader = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/EngineLoader.${language}`);
	const normalize = (path) => path.replaceAll('\\', '/');
	let config;
	return {
		name: 'asam-visualization-engine-url',
		configResolved(value) {
			config = value;
		},
		transform(code, id) {
			if (normalize(id.split('?')[0]) !== normalize(loader)) return;
			const marker = /['"]__ASAM_ENGINE_URL__['"]/;
			if (!marker.test(code)) this.error('EngineLoader.ts 缺少预期的引擎 URL 标记');
			const path = normalize(relative(config.root, engine));
			const devPath = path.startsWith('../') ? '@fs/' + normalize(engine) : path;
			const url =
				config.command === 'build'
					? `import.meta.ROLLUP_FILE_URL_${this.emitFile({ type: 'chunk', id: engine, name: 'Engine', preserveSignature: 'strict' })}`
					: // This is already a Vite-served URL with its base applied. Prevent
						// Vite's asset new-URL transform from resolving it as another file.
						`/* @vite-ignore */ ${JSON.stringify(config.base + encodeURI(devPath))}`;
			return { code: code.replace(marker, url), map: null };
		}
	};
}

import { computed } from 'vue';
/** 公共输入允许清空或多种标量，页面模型只接收自己声明的合法值。 */
export function choiceModel(read, write, choices) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (choices.some((choice) => Object.is(choice, value))) write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function booleanModel(read, write) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (typeof value === 'boolean') write(value);
		}
	});
}
export function textModel(read, write) {
	return computed({
		get: read,
		set(value) {
			if (typeof value === 'string') write(value);
		}
	});
}

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef } from 'vue';
export function useDashboardMetricLayout(page) {
	const width = shallowRef(1440);
	const columns = computed(() => (width.value < 700 ? 1 : width.value < 1100 ? 2 : 4));
	let observer;
	onMounted(() => {
		const element = page.value;
		if (!element) return;
		const measure = () => {
			width.value = element.getBoundingClientRect().width;
		};
		measure();
		observer = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		observer.observe(element);
	});
	onBeforeUnmount(() => observer?.disconnect());
	return { width, columns };
}

import { reactive, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { monitorRegions, monitorStreams } from './Types.js';
/** 本地源严格遵守已有SubscribeSource；不创建EventSource或真实接口。 */
export function createBusinessMonitorFixture() {
	const controls = reactive({
		mode: 'normal',
		delayMs: 80,
		identity: 1
	});
	const audit = reactive({ subscriptions: 0, closed: 0, active: 0, delivered: 0 });
	const cleanups = new Set();
	const source = {
		id: 'local-business-monitor',
		subscribe(sink) {
			++audit.subscriptions;
			++audit.active;
			let active = true,
				tick = 0,
				interval;
			const identity = controls.identity,
				mode = controls.mode,
				delay = controls.delayMs;
			function emit(stream, seq, value, at = Date.now()) {
				if (!active) return;
				++audit.delivered;
				sink.message({ stream, seq, at, value });
			}
			function frame() {
				const values = {
					online: 1286 + tick,
					processed: 9120 + (tick % 10) * 20,
					response: 1.8,
					success: 99.6,
					goal: 12000,
					current: 90,
					previous: 65,
					north: 3200,
					south: 2400,
					east: 1900,
					west: 1620,
					asset: 2846,
					workflow: 1927,
					knowledge: 1456,
					backlog: 128,
					assetChange: 12.6,
					workflowChange: 8.2,
					knowledgeChange: 6.8,
					backlogChange: -5.2
				};
				for (const stream of monitorStreams) {
					if (
						stream === 'current' ||
						stream === 'previous' ||
						monitorRegions.some((region) => region === stream)
					)
						continue;
					emit(
						stream,
						tick,
						mode === 'empty' || (mode === 'partial' && stream === 'response')
							? null
							: values[stream] * (stream === 'online' ? identity : 1)
					);
				}
				const length = tick === 0 ? 12 : 1;
				for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
					const seq = tick === 0 ? i : 11 + tick;
					const at = Date.now() - (length - i - 1) * 1000;
					monitorRegions.forEach((region, index) =>
						emit(
							region,
							seq,
							mode === 'empty' || (mode === 'partial' && region === 'east')
								? null
								: values[region] + ((seq % 12) - 11) * (index + 1) * 9,
							at
						)
					);
					emit(
						'current',
						seq,
						mode === 'empty'
							? null
							: [39, 62, 51, 84, 65, 93, 58, 78, 63, 88, 98, 73][seq % 12],
						at
					);
					emit(
						'previous',
						seq,
						mode === 'empty'
							? null
							: [30, 42, 44, 59, 48, 65, 50, 67, 46, 74, 79, 65][seq % 12],
						at
					);
				}
				++tick;
			}
			function close() {
				if (!active) return;
				active = false;
				clearTimeout(initial);
				if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
				++audit.closed;
				--audit.active;
				cleanups.delete(close);
			}
			const initial = setTimeout(() => {
				if (!active) return;
				if (mode === 'error') {
					sink.error();
					return;
				}
				sink.open();
				frame();
				interval = setInterval(frame, 1000);
			}, delay);
			cleanups.add(close);
			return { close };
		}
	};
	const host = shallowRef({ owner: { identity: 1 }, source });
	return {
		host,
		controls,
		audit,
		switchIdentity() {
			++controls.identity;
			host.value = { owner: { identity: controls.identity }, source };
		},
		dispose() {
			for (const close of [...cleanups]) close();
		}
	};
}

<script setup>
import { computed, provide, shallowRef, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCard,
	AsamButton,
	AsamOption,
	AsamSelect,
	AsamTag,
	AsamProgress,
	AsamDivider,
	AsamTable,
	AsamTableColumn,
	AsamEmpty
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { AsamCardGroup, AsamStatisticCard } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import ChartHost from '../../visualization/ChartHost.vue';
import { businessValue, monitorRegions } from './Types.js';
import { useBusinessMonitor } from './State.js';
import { useBusinessMonitorText } from './I18n.js';
import { useDashboardMetricLayout } from '../MetricLayout.js';
const props = defineProps({
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	theme: { type: String, required: false, default: 'light' }
});
const { i18n, t } = useBusinessMonitorText();
provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
const { width, columns } = useDashboardMetricLayout(useTemplateRef('page'));
const state = useBusinessMonitor(() => props.host),
	locale = computed(() => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh-CN')),
	chartLocale = computed(() => (locale.value === 'en' ? 'EN' : 'ZH'));
const stateLabel = computed(
	() =>
		({
			idle: t('idle'),
			connecting: t('connecting'),
			live: t('live'),
			reconnecting: t('reconnecting'),
			paused: t('statePaused'),
			stale: t('stateStale'),
			error: t('stateError'),
			closed: t('stateClosed')
		})[state.snapshot.value.state]
);
const feedback = computed(() =>
	t(
		state.snapshot.value.state === 'paused'
			? 'paused'
			: state.snapshot.value.state === 'closed'
				? 'closed'
				: state.snapshot.value.state === 'stale'
					? 'stale'
					: state.status.value === 'loading'
						? 'loading'
						: state.status.value === 'error'
							? 'error'
							: state.status.value === 'empty'
								? 'empty'
								: state.partial.value
									? 'partial'
									: 'ready'
	)
);
const value = (id) => businessValue(state.visible.value, id);
const metrics = computed(() =>
	['online', 'processed', 'response', 'success'].map((id) => ({
		id,
		value: value(id)
	}))
);
const goalProgress = computed(() => {
	const goal = value('goal'),
		processed = value('processed');
	if (goal === null || goal <= 0 || processed === null) return undefined;
	return {
		goal,
		processed,
		remaining: Math.max(0, goal - processed),
		percentage: Math.min(100, Math.round((processed / goal) * 1000) / 10)
	};
});
const number = (value) =>
	new Intl.NumberFormat(locale.value, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(value);
const date = (value) =>
	new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale.value, {
		hour: '2-digit',
		minute: '2-digit',
		second: '2-digit'
	}).format(value);
const region = shallowRef('all');
function selectRegion(value) {
	if (value === 'all') {
		region.value = value;
		return;
	}
	const selected = monitorRegions.find((id) => id === value);
	if (selected) region.value = selected;
}
const trend = computed(() => {
	const streams = region.value === 'all' ? ['current', 'previous'] : [region.value];
	return streams.map((id) => ({
		id,
		name: t(id),
		kind: 'line',
		points: (state.visible.value?.points[id] ?? []).map((p) => ({
			id: String(p.seq),
			label: date(p.at),
			value: p.value
		}))
	}));
});
const regions = computed(() => [
	{
		id: 'regions',
		name: t('regions'),
		kind: 'bar',
		points: monitorRegions.map((id) => ({
			id,
			label: t(id),
			value: value(id)
		}))
	}
]);
const hotspots = computed(() =>
	!state.visible.value || state.status.value === 'empty'
		? []
		: ['asset', 'workflow', 'knowledge', 'backlog'].map((id) => ({
				id,
				label: t(id),
				value: value(id),
				change: value(`${id}Change`)
			}))
);
const updatedAt = computed(() => {
	const at = state.visible.value?.lastAt;
	return at === undefined || at === null ? t('unavailable') : date(at);
});
const chartError = computed(() => (state.status.value === 'error' ? t('error') : ''));
const bodyStyle = { padding: 'var(--asam-space-xl)' };
</script>

import { computed, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { createMonitor } from '../../visualization/Monitor.js';
import { businessValue, monitorStreams } from './Types.js';
/** 每页独立容器；只编排宿主变化，连接/时序/缓冲/取消仍由既有Monitor实现。 */
export function useBusinessMonitor(host) {
	const snapshot = shallowRef({
		state: 'idle',
		source: '',
		attempts: 0,
		dropped: 0,
		lastAt: null,
		points: {}
	});
	let monitor;
	let disposed = false;
	watch(
		() => [host().owner, host().source],
		() => {
			monitor?.dispose();
			monitor = createMonitor(
				{
					streams: [...monitorStreams],
					capacity: 60,
					intervalMs: 1000,
					batchMs: 100,
					reconnects: 0
				},
				(value) => {
					snapshot.value = value;
				}
			);
			snapshot.value = monitor.snapshot();
			monitor.start(host().source);
		},
		{ immediate: true, flush: 'sync' }
	);
	const visible = computed(() =>
		['live', 'paused', 'stale'].includes(snapshot.value.state) ? snapshot.value : undefined
	);
	const available = computed(() =>
		monitorStreams.some((id) => businessValue(visible.value, id) !== null)
	);
	const status = computed(() =>
		'error' === snapshot.value.state
			? 'error'
			: ['idle', 'connecting', 'reconnecting'].includes(snapshot.value.state)
				? 'loading'
				: available.value
					? 'ready'
					: 'empty'
	);
	const partial = computed(
		() =>
			available.value &&
			monitorStreams.some((id) => businessValue(visible.value, id) === null)
	);
	onScopeDispose(() => {
		disposed = true;
		monitor?.dispose();
		snapshot.value = {
			state: 'closed',
			source: '',
			attempts: 0,
			dropped: 0,
			lastAt: null,
			points: {}
		};
	});
	return {
		snapshot: computed(() => snapshot.value),
		visible,
		status,
		partial,
		pause: () => monitor?.pause(),
		resume: () => monitor?.resume(),
		reconnect: () => monitor?.reconnect(),
		close: () => monitor?.close(),
		resources: () => monitor?.resources(),
		get disposed() {
			return disposed;
		}
	};
}

export const monitorRegions = ['north', 'south', 'east', 'west'];
export const monitorStreams = [
	'online',
	'processed',
	'response',
	'success',
	'goal',
	'current',
	'previous',
	...monitorRegions,
	'asset',
	'workflow',
	'knowledge',
	'backlog',
	'assetChange',
	'workflowChange',
	'knowledgeChange',
	'backlogChange'
];
/** 空或业务范围不合法的值保持缺失，不将缺失补成零。 */
export function businessValue(snapshot, stream) {
	const value = snapshot?.points[stream]?.at(-1)?.value;
	if (value === undefined || value === null || !Number.isFinite(value)) return null;
	if (!stream.endsWith('Change') && value < 0) return null;
	if (stream === 'success' && value > 100) return null;
	return value;
}

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
/** 演示宿主拥有本地源；外部语言实例仍归调用者。 */
export function mountMonitorWorkspace(element, host, onError) {
	const locale = shallowRef('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const app = createApp(App, {
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		diagnostics: host?.diagnostics,
		onLocale: (value) => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'dashboard-monitor-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

/** Validate before invoking the engine. Null is a gap, zero and signed decimals are values. */
export function validateSeries(series, scope) {
	const ids = new Set();
	for (const item of series) {
		if (!item.id || ids.has(item.id))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.seriesId')
				: 'series ID 缺失或重复';
		ids.add(item.id);
		if (!['line', 'bar', 'pie'].includes(item.kind))
			return scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.chartKind')
				: '未注册的图表类型';
		const points = new Set();
		for (const point of item.points) {
			if (!point.id || points.has(point.id))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.pointId')
					: 'point ID 缺失或重复';
			points.add(point.id);
			if (point.value !== null && !Number.isFinite(point.value))
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.finite')
					: '图表值必须为有限数字或 null';
			if (item.kind === 'pie' && point.value !== null && point.value < 0)
				return scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.visualization.negativePie')
					: '饼图不支持负数；请使用折线或柱图';
		}
	}
}

import { LineChart, BarChart, PieChart } from 'echarts/charts';

	BarChart,
	PieChart,
	GridComponent,
	TooltipComponent,
	LegendComponent,
	DataZoomComponent,
	AriaComponent,
	SVGRenderer
]);
export { init };

/** Vite resolves this marker to its own emitted entry, including the configured base URL.
 * A fresh URL on retry avoids the browser's cached rejected dynamic-import promise.
 * No remote scripts, copied engine code or alternate dependency instance are used.
 */
let loaded;
export async function loadEngine(attempt) {
	if (loaded) return loaded;
	const url = new URL('__ASAM_ENGINE_URL__', import.meta.url);
	if (attempt > 0) url.searchParams.set('asam-retry', String(attempt));
	const engine = await import(/* @vite-ignore */ url.href);
	loaded = engine;
	return engine;
}

.viz-shell {
	--viz-bg: var(--asam-color-surface-muted, #f3f6f7);
	--viz-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--viz-text: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #20363e);
	--viz-border: var(--asam-color-border, #d8e1e5);
	--viz-control: 32px;
	background: var(--viz-bg);
	color: var(--viz-text);
	min-height: 100%;
	font: 14px/1.5 var(--asam-typography-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);
}
.viz-shell.dark {
	color-scheme: dark;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='large'] {
	--viz-control: 40px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='big'] {
	--viz-control: 36px;
}
.viz-shell[data-size='small'] {
	--viz-control: 28px;
}
body {
	margin: 0;
}
.viz-shell * {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}
.viz-shell nav {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	padding: 16px 3vw;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.viz-shell nav strong {
	margin-right: auto;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-shell small {
	font-size: 10px;
	font-weight: 400;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-']),
.viz-shell select:not([class*='el-']) {
	font: inherit;
	color: inherit;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control, 4px);
	min-height: var(--viz-control);
	line-height: 20px;
	padding: 3px 10px;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
	cursor: pointer;
}
.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']):hover,
.viz-shell [aria-current='page']:not(.el-button) {
	border-color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
}
.viz-shell :focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 3px;
}
.viz-shell input:not([class*='el-'])[type='checkbox'] {
	min-height: 0;
}
.viz-page {
	max-width: 1600px;
	margin: auto;
	padding: 28px 3vw;
}
.viz-heading {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 16px;
	margin-bottom: 22px;
}
.viz-heading h1 {
	font-size: 32px;
	letter-spacing: -0.035em;
	margin: 4px 0;
}
.viz-heading p {
	margin: 0;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-eyebrow {
	font-size: 11px;
	letter-spacing: 0.12em;
}
.viz-toolbar {
	display: flex;
	align-items: end;
	gap: 12px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.viz-toolbar label {
	display: grid;
	gap: 4px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-shell nav label {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 5px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
	gap: 18px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-analysis-grid > .viz-chart:first-child {
	grid-column: 1/-1;
}
.viz-monitor-grid {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
	gap: 16px;
	margin-top: 24px;
}
.viz-chart {
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 18px;
	background: var(--viz-surface);
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-card, 8px);
}
.viz-chart header {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: space-between;
}
.viz-chart h2 {
	font-size: 15px;
	margin: 0 0 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section {
	border: 0;
	padding: 0;
	display: flex;
	gap: 12px;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-chart .asam-form-section-title {
	font-size: 11px;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary, #657983);
}
.viz-plot {
	width: 100%;
}
.viz-chart summary {
	cursor: pointer;
	font-size: 12px;
	margin-top: 12px;
}
.viz-table {
	max-height: 260px;
	overflow: auto;
}
.viz-table table {
	border-collapse: collapse;
	width: 100%;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.viz-table th,
.viz-table td {
	text-align: left;
	padding: 6px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
}
.viz-status {
	border: 1px solid var(--viz-border);
	padding: 6px 12px;
	border-radius: 20px;
}
.viz-shell .asam-card-group {
	margin: 18px 0;
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.viz-analysis-grid,
	.viz-monitor-grid {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.viz-heading h1 {
		font-size: 26px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav {
		gap: 9px;
	}
	.viz-shell nav strong {
		width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-toolbar input:not([class*='el-']) {
		max-width: 100%;
	}
	.viz-chart {
		padding: 12px;
	}
	.viz-page {
		padding: 20px 14px;
	}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.viz-shell button:not([class*='el-']) {
		transition:
			border-color 0.15s,
			color 0.15s;
	}
	.viz-page {
		animation: viz-enter 0.18s ease-out;
	}
	@keyframes viz-enter {
		from {
			opacity: 0.4;
			transform: translateY(3px);
		}
		to {
			opacity: 1;
			transform: none;
		}
	}
}

import { resolve, relative } from 'node:path';

// Keep the accepted loader's retryable dynamic import. Only resolve its URL to
// Vite's own emitted entry; the engine and chart algorithms remain unchanged.
export function asamVisualizationEngine(
	sourceRoot = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..'),
	{ language = 'js' } = {}
) {
	if (!['ts', 'js'].includes(language)) throw Error('图表引擎仅支持TS或JS同源入口');
	const engine = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/Engine.${language}`);
	const loader = resolve(sourceRoot, `templates/visualization/EngineLoader.${language}`);
	const normalize = (path) => path.replaceAll('\\', '/');
	let config;
	return {
		name: 'asam-visualization-engine-url',
		configResolved(value) {
			config = value;
		},
		transform(code, id) {
			if (normalize(id.split('?')[0]) !== normalize(loader)) return;
			const marker = /['"]__ASAM_ENGINE_URL__['"]/;
			if (!marker.test(code)) this.error('EngineLoader.ts 缺少预期的引擎 URL 标记');
			const path = normalize(relative(config.root, engine));
			const devPath = path.startsWith('../') ? '@fs/' + normalize(engine) : path;
			const url =
				config.command === 'build'
					? `import.meta.ROLLUP_FILE_URL_${this.emitFile({ type: 'chunk', id: engine, name: 'Engine', preserveSignature: 'strict' })}`
					: // This is already a Vite-served URL with its base applied. Prevent
						// Vite's asset new-URL transform from resolving it as another file.
						`/* @vite-ignore */ ${JSON.stringify(config.base + encodeURI(devPath))}`;
			return { code: code.replace(marker, url), map: null };
		}
	};
}

独立业务监控页：当前在线、今日处理、平均响应、成功率，配合两期趋势、目标进度、区域处理量和热点任务。本地合成源真实驱动前端，不连接后台服务。

前端宿主契约

接口说明
MonitorPage.host提供当前owner引用及原MonitorSource；真实业务映射由宿主负责。
MonitorPage.themelight或dark，同步传给真实图表引擎，默认light。
BusinessMonitorHost.owner身份或数据权限改变时替换引用；页面释放旧订阅并清除旧快照。
BusinessMonitorHost.source复用原SubscribeSource或PollSource，不新增网络或SSE算法。
StreamPoint原协议的stream、seq、at、value；null表示缺失。19个业务流ID详见Types.ts及README。
mountMonitorWorkspace挂载本地合成演示并返回幂等释放函数；外部i18n仍归调用者。

监控页 ​

独立 /dashboard/monitor 前端模板，按已确认 B R6.1 monitor 分支组织四指标、处理趋势、目标进度、区域分布和热点任务。目标进度来自已处理量与目标量；确认稿未提供倒计时终点，本例不新增业务倒计时。原通用 templates/visualization/examples/MonitorPage.vue、Monitor.ts、SSE/轮询服务与协议保持原样。

MonitorPage.vue 接受 BusinessMonitorHost 和可选 theme。宿主提供当前 owner 引用及既有 MonitorSource（订阅或轮询源）。身份或权限变化必须替换 owner 引用，页面立即释放旧容器并清除旧快照。宿主负责真实业务到 StreamPoint 的映射，源 ID 应保持可识别；不把演示地址当真实接口。

流 ID 在 Types.ts 中逐项声明：online、processed、response、success、goal 对应在线、今日处理、响应秒数、成功率百分比及今日目标；current/previous 为两期处理趋势；north/south/east/west 为区域处理量；asset/workflow/knowledge/backlog 及相应 Change 流为热点量与变化百分比。null 表示缺失，标量计数不接受负数，成功率范围为 0～100，变化百分比允许负数。没有把缺失值补成零。

State.ts 每页创建独立 createMonitor，容量60、批次100ms、健康检查1000ms。订阅自动重连次数为0，错误可由用户显式刷新；轮询节奏与失败处理保留原 Monitor 语义，其通用配置能力不回退。暂停实际关闭订阅/中止轮询并冻结当前快照；继续和刷新沿原 Monitor 重新连接并清除旧数据；关闭隐藏业务快照，可再次刷新。源发生错误、宿主变化和卸载均不会接纳旧代迟到数据。源最后时间与失去更新状态仍由原协议提供，不新增另一时序/重连算法。

真实复用 ASAM 统计卡、卡片、按钮、进度、表格、标签、空态以及原 ChartHost / ChartSeries / Engine。图表保留原图例、可访问数据表、主题语言和减少动态能力。App.vue、Fixture.ts、mount.ts 是本地合成宿主，提供正常、空、部分、失败、首包延迟和身份切换；它们不创建 EventSource、网络服务、真实业务 DTO/API 或平台宿主。

TS / JS 展示、复制、源码 ZIP、正常包工程与实际运行使用同一既有公开投影。完整工程附正常包归档、原锁、原 workspace 补丁配置、图表引擎构建插件及作者类型上下文。使用 pnpm 安装，运行 pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run build 或 pnpm run dev。外部语言实例与业务源归调用者，页面释放自己的订阅容器；本地演示宿主另释放其自有定时器。
